desc:
[THE GAME IS STILL IN DEVELOPMENT STAGE]
Expect bugs, everything still has the possibility of change

🏆 There can be only one champion, are you? 

Default Controls:

Keyboard:
V - Change camera point of view
C - Swap between cameras
Shift + C - Freecam
E/Q - Shift Up/Down Gear
M - Change transmission (Auto/Semi-Auto/Manual)
Shift - Rear Brake
R - Toggle RHD (Rear Height Device)
T - Toggle TCS
Y - Toggle ABS
G - Toggle Body Weight

Gamepad:
R1 - Rear Brake
R2 - Throttle
L1 - Clutch
L2 - Front Brake
B - Toggle RHD (Rear Height Device)
Y/X - Shift Up/Down Gear
Up - Change transmission (Auto/Semi-Auto/Manual)
Down - TCS
Right - ABS
Left - Change camera point of view
